Page 156 Cont.
Sept. 20 Fred. Griffith - 52 - of Hamilton Ont. - Lukemia - a convert for 25 yrs. has been receiving lately - Fam. otherwise have very little faith if any kind.
26 Veronica Kaled - Blain Hosp. - 47 - "dying of internal cancer .... Enrolled To-day
Abdon Vander Tesshe - 80 - injured by Auto - feared to be dying Mrs. M. Walsh - about 65 - mother of 6 - 3 priests, 2 nuns Ralph Sheehan - 42 - Escellent man and husband ... but weak for drink.
Frank Edgeworth - 48 - drinking - neglecting wife and six. ..
Page 157 Sept. 27 Wm. Demery - 16 - accident last Friday - now in Carmel Hosp. 1939, October
Oct. 3 Mrs. Nora Hellner Ann Arbor - 53 - stomach cancer - Drs. give her a few months
3 Mrs. 0. W. Preece - 57 - of Jackson - was threatened three yrs ago with serious operation - had blood poison - was given one hour to live. Prayed to Our Bl. Mother ... of Victory - astonished the doc- tors. Now threatened with operation on hand sist ... Enroled Pro- misses to read City of God.
Thanks - Pasquitina Palidori - 31 - was blind in both eyes for six or seven weeks. Was Enrolled July 10th. Is here, Can see O.K.
Angeline Renne - 17 - in quite similar trouble to that just described - blind in one eye and sees very little with other.
3 Thanks. . . Mary Jane Murphy - 8 - prayed for two week ago - then in Hosp. (Kiefer) with "infantile" - Home To-day perfect ....
Page 158 Oct. 3rd Mrs. Maude Crawford - 59 - operation this a.m. at 10 o'cl. on what threatened to be breast cancer -
